scope_definition: routes.discipline IN ('alpine','mountaineering') AND routes.id LIKE 'wa_%' AND routes.area_id IN (SELECT id FROM areas WHERE area_type = 'peak'), ordered by routes.id ASC
scope_note: area_type = 'peak' excludes crags/walls (e.g. The Dikes, Summertime Crag) that carry an alpine/mountaineering discipline tag but are actually short cragging routes, not mountaineering objectives — out of scope per audit instructions.

batches.note: wa_big_kangaroo_southwest_rib flagged: its own id implies a route ('Southwest Rib') that belongs to a different peak entirely; row content is correct for Big Kangaroo's real 'West Face/West Route' but the id itself needs a human rename decision, not auto-fixed.

Two significant structural flags this batch, neither auto-fixed: wa_cascade_peak_east_ridge is a half-corrected row (overview rewritten to describe Cascade Peak's real NW Chimney route, but aspect/face/approach/corrections/seasonal_guidance still describe the previously-conflated Johannesburg Mountain East Ridge); wa_boston_peak_southwest_face duplicates its SE Face sibling's beta almost verbatim while its own fa/corrections fields describe a different, real West Face route — internally incoherent about which route it documents. Both need a human rewrite/split decision, not a field patch.

Cross-referenced sibling routes on the same peak (Unicorn Peak, Chimney Rock) directly from the DB to confirm two elevation errors: wa_classic_route_2's summit waypoint (6,867 ft) was the sole outlier against 3 other Unicorn Peak routes and Wikipedia (all 6,971 ft); wa_chimney_rock_west_face's high_point_ft (7,727 ft) matched its sibling East Face route but actually belongs to Chimney Rock's separate main/central summit, not the lower South Summit (7,440 ft, confirmed via Wikipedia) that this specific route's own name/waypoints/approach text describe climbing. Also repeated the exact 'Chiwawa/Entiat Ranger Districts' nonexistent-district error found and fixed for Bonanza Peak in batch 4, this time on wa_chiwawa_mountain_southwest -- same fix applied (Wenatchee River Ranger District).

Two more id/name-mismatch cases in the same family as batch 3's wa_big_kangaroo_southwest_rib: wa_colonial_peak_northeast's id says 'northeast' but the row (name, overview, face, waypoints) consistently describes the peak's real standard route, 'West Ridge / Colonial Glacier'; wa_corteo_peak_southeast_face's id says 'southeast_face' but the row describes the real standard 'Southwest Ridge / Standard Route'. Both flagged for a human rename decision, not auto-fixed. Also found and fixed a new pattern: Kimchi Suicide Volcano (Colfax Peak) had a null top-level grade despite already having verified ice_grade (AI4+) and rock_grade (M5) on file -- filled from the row's own verified sub-fields rather than external data.

Fixed a repeated 8050-vs-8066 elevation contradiction across four Cutthroat Peak routes (three had a stale high_point_ft, one had a stale summit waypoint), all now aligned to Wikipedia's 8,066 ft and the area's own elevation_ft. Also fixed a stale elevation typo in Sloan Peak's area blurb (7,839 -> 7,835 ft, matching its own elevation_ft/prominence_ft columns). New pattern this batch: wa_cutthroat_peak_r1 ('South Buttress Direct') and wa_cutthroat_south_buttress ('South Buttress') appear to be the same real Beckey/Gordon-1958 route entered twice under different IDs -- flagged as a likely duplicate needing a human merge/rename decision, not auto-fixed. Also flagged a 3-way grade conflict on Crooked Thumb Peak's South Route and a 3-way elevation conflict on Dark Peak (8518 area / 8507 route / 8504 waypoint) where sourcing couldn't confirm which figure is right.

Bear Mountain's Direct North Buttress (wa_direct_north_buttress) had the most significant errors found this pass: fa/pitches/length_m/commitment/season all conflicted with the row's own overview/beta text and external sources -- looked like data pasted in from a different route/ascent record (stored a 2016 repeat ascent as the FA instead of the real 1980 Kearney/Knight FA; stored 5 pitches/274m/Grade IV/winter-ice season instead of the real 21 pitches/~670m/Grade V/summer-rock). Also fixed a mislabeled NPS entrance-fee claim there (North Cascades NP charges none; the real requirement is a Forest Service Northwest Forest Pass at the trailhead). Two more copy-paste artifacts fixed on Dome Peak's Dome Glacier route (wrong county in a hazard note, wrong trailhead corridor in a parking-pass note) and two internal gain_ft-vs-itinerary self-contradictions fixed on wa_direct_southwest_buttress (Dorado Needle) and wa_dolphin_chimney (SEWS). New duplicate-ID pattern found on Dragontail Peak, same family as prior batches' id/name-mismatch flags but this time full duplicate rows: wa_dragontail_peak_backbone_ridge appears to duplicate the separate row wa_backbone_ridge (same route, same FA), and wa_dragontail_peak_r4 appears to duplicate wa_dragontail_peak_triple_couloirs (both 'Triple Couloirs', same FA) -- both flagged for a human merge/delete decision, not auto-fixed. Also flagged: Dome Peak's own high_point_ft (8920) vs its area elevation_ft (8926) -- genuine source conflict (LiDAR vs older figures), not resolved; an ambiguous III/III+ grade text on wa_direct_southwest_buttress that appears copy-pasted from the standard (non-Direct) route it's a variant of; and several 'needs human verification' items (Bear Mountain's 'Gerber-Sink' face note and WI5+ ice_grade on what sources show as a summer rock route; Dolphin Chimney's descent/rappel sourcing and gain-vs-waypoint-implied-minimum gap).

Pandora's Box (wa_dragontail_peak_r3) was this batch's biggest find: a prior 2026-07-15 enrichment pass rewrote the route's prose to correctly describe it as a moderate unroped SW-facing snow/scramble couloir, but left 8 structured fields (grade_system/grade_num, disciplines, pitches, pitch_detail, rappels, obj_haz, climate, approach/timing/itinerary text) still describing the debunked fabricated WI6 ice/mixed route, self-contradicting the row's own corrected prose -- all 8 fixed to match. Confirmed the wa_dragontail_peak_r4 / wa_dragontail_peak_triple_couloirs duplicate flagged in batch 8 (identical FA/pitches/length across both rows) -- still needs a human merge/delete decision, not auto-fixed; also fixed 3 'Asgard'->'Aasgard' misspellings on r4 and one bad Aasgard Pass coordinate on wa_dragontail_peak_serpentine_arete (its own waypoints/gpx arrays carried two conflicting entries for the same named point). One review-agent proposed changing alpine_grade from 'D' to 'IV' on wa_dragontail_peak_triple_couloirs, citing NCCS-grade sources -- rejected after checking supabase/migrations/0006_composite_grades.sql, which defines alpine_grade as the French adjectival scale (F/PD/AD/D/TD/ED), not the commitment grade; applied the corrected fix in the other direction instead (r4's alpine_grade 'IV' -> 'D', matching both the schema's intent and its duplicate sibling's existing value). wa_east_ridge_2 (Snowking Mountain) had the same North-Cascades-NP-vs-Forest-Service copy-paste pattern as batch 8's Bear Mountain fix: access.land_manager and access.notes/rules wrongly carried NPS Boston-Basin-lottery boilerplate on a Mt. Baker-Snoqualmie NF route, plus a beta/pitch_detail text contradiction claiming a glacier crossing on a route whose own overview calls itself the 'non-glaciated' line. wa_e_se_face (Witches Tower) had likely cross-route contamination: its descent/itinerary describe a mandatory roped 5.6 pitch that contradicts its own 4th-class grade fields, apparently bled in from a separate, real 'Southeast Face' 5.6 route on the same peak -- flagged for a human rewrite/split, not patched. wa_east_ridge_3 (Silver Star Mountain) returned no confirmed fixes at all: its own approach/beta text names a different trailhead (Cedar Creek) than its own waypoints (Silver Star Creek), suggesting a two-route merge, but every verification source (SummitPost, Mountain Project, NWMJ) 403'd during this run -- entirely flagged for a human with guidebook/primary-source access. wa_east_face_6 (Chimney Rock) audited clean -- correctly avoided the summit-mismatch error found on its sibling West Face route in batch 5.

Elephant Butte's area row (elevation_ft/prominence_ft) was the sole outlier against Wikipedia and its own route/waypoint data -- fixed. Eldorado Peak East Ridge's high_point_ft (8876) was the sole outlier against 3 sibling Eldorado routes plus a prior batch's own corrections note settling on 8872 -- fixed. Thread of Ice had a null top-level grade despite verified grade_num/rock_grade on file, same pattern as batch 6's Kimchi fix -- filled. Biggest open flag: East Twin Needle South Route's top-level grade text (5.7) contradicts its own rock_grade/commitment/beta-quoted source grade (II 5.10a) -- left flagged per the established route-identity-conflation precedent rather than guessed.

Forbidden Peak North Ridge had a wildly wrong high_point_ft (10781, not Forbidden Peak at all -- real summit is 8815, confirmed by its own waypoint + area row + 3 sibling routes) and a grade_num (3) that looks like the "III" commitment token misread instead of the 5.6 YDS grade -- both fixed. Biggest open flag: wa_forbidden_peak_east_ridge is very likely a duplicate of wa_forbidden_peak_east_ridge_direct (same FA party/year, same grade/pitch count, and the row's own data_quality note already says so) -- left flagged rather than auto-merged/deleted per guardrails. Also flagged: East Face/Catscratch's own corrections note says the route name conflates two unrelated Forbidden Peak features and its 5.9 grade fields don't match the class-4 terrain described; Fire on the Mountain has three disagreeing length/pitch-count figures (pitch_detail sum 380m vs beta 333m vs stored length_m 457m); Elephant Head Standard's FA ("Jim Nelson 1982, Northwest Ridge") doesn't match the Dana Glacier line this row actually describes.

Forbidden Peak Northeast Face had its fa (and, tied to it, grade_num) contaminated with a different peak's FA data entirely -- Beckey/Burgner/Nephew 1972 is documented elsewhere as Dragontail Peak's Northeast Buttress FA (1971), not this route; the row's own pitch_detail matches a 1961 AAJ account by Ed Cooper and Stuart Ferguson almost verbatim, so fa was fixed to that party and the orphaned grade_num (7, matching Dragontail's own 5.7 grade) was cleared since this row's rock_grade is Class 3-4, not 5th class. Fortress Mountain's own East Ridge route had already researched and settled an elevation conflict (Wikipedia 8679 vs Peakbagger 8684) in its corrections note but the actual stored elevation/high_point_ft/waypoints across the area and all 3 routes still said 8684 -- fixed to match the row's own recorded decision. Also repeated two error patterns from earlier batches: the same nonexistent 'Chiwawa/Entiat Ranger Districts' land_manager error (Bonanza Peak batch 4, Chiwawa Mountain batch 5) on all 3 Fortress Mountain routes, and a wrong-forest land_manager (Mt. Baker-Snoqualmie instead of Okanogan-Wenatchee/Cle Elum) on both Fortune Peak routes -- both fixed from each row's own correct landManager field. Flagged rather than fixed: Fortress Mountain's 'Northeast Face' is called 'Northeast Ridge' by every source per its own corrections note (name/id conflation, same family as prior batches' Big Kangaroo/Colonial Peak/Corteo Peak flags); Frenzel Spitz South Route's top-level grade ('Grade III') conflicts with its own commitment field ('II') with no source found specific enough to resolve it.

Glacier Peak's own area blurb and three of its five routes agree the White Chuck Road (FR-23) closure is due to December 2024 flood damage, confirmed against the real USFS closure order (effective Mar 2025, responding to the preceding December's damage); wa_glacier_peak_disappointment_cleaver was the sole outlier claiming 'Dec 2025' and was fixed. A real, separate, larger December 2025 storm did hit the North Cascades (confirmed via UW Climate Impacts Group/Cascade Backcountry Alliance reporting) and washed out the Suiattle River Road (FSR 26) -- that's the correct, left-alone basis for this same route's other 'extremely limited access as of April 2026' note; only the White-Chuck-Road-specific year was wrong. Also fixed a repeated FA misspelling ('Dubois' -> 'Dubor' for 1897 USGS surveyor A. H. Dubor) on 2 of Glacier Peak's 5 routes, an outlier summit-elevation waypoint (10550 -> 10541 ft) on Frostbite Ridge, and a self-contradicting corrections note on Gilbert Peak Meade Glacier that claimed a 8,201 ft benchmark elevation was used when the row's actual stored high_point_ft (8,184 ft, matching Wikipedia/USGS) was never changed to match that claim. One item left flagged: wa_glacier_peak_disappointment_cleaver's own corrections field already documents its name conflating two distinct routes and recommends a rename/split, a human decision not auto-fixed. wa_frying_pan_whitman_glaciers's existing likely-duplicate flag against wa_little_tahoma_east_shoulder was independently confirmed (identical FA/elevation) but is not new.

Megalodon Ridge's own fa field claimed a 2008 FA date ('primary AAC/Alpinist coverage confirms 2008'), contradicting its own overview/beta text and the Mount Goode area blurb (both correctly say 2007) -- verified externally (Alpinist's 2007 newswire, Climbing.com) that the ascent was September 6, 2007, and the 2008 figure was the AAJ's publication year, not the climb year; fixed. Also fixed a misspelling in the same area's blurb ('Dickett' -> 'Dickert' for 1936 FA member Phil Dickert, confirmed externally and already spelled correctly in the route's own fa field), and a self-contradiction on Southwest Couloir where the route's own itinerary.sourceNote already claimed 'gainFt was corrected to 8,400 ft' but the stored gain_ft column still read 5,300 -- applied the correction the row itself already described. Gunsight Peak's area elevation_ft/prominence_ft (8185/546) conflicted with its own Standard Route's summit waypoint (8198) and a prominence conflict the route's own data_quality note already flagged as unresolved; verified externally (8,198 ft / 518 ft prominence) and fixed both the area and the Standard Route's high_point_ft. Note: sibling wa_gunsight_peak_east_face carries the same ~2 ft elevation slip (8200) but is tagged discipline 'trad', outside this audit's scope, so it was left untouched and flagged here rather than silently fixed. Goat Mountain's area elevation_ft (6892) was the sole outlier against its own South Ridge route's overview/hazards/waypoint (6891), the sibling East Peak route's high_point_ft (6891), and SummitPost's East-Peak-specific figure (6891 vs the West Peak's 6721) -- fixed the area plus two stray '6,892 ft' mentions inside the South Ridge route's own itinerary JSON.
flags: wa_goat_mountain_south_ridge: its own high_point_ft (6721, the West Peak) doesn't match its own overview/itinerary narrative, which describes continuing on to tag the true East Peak summit (6891 ft) -- content that properly belongs to the separate sibling route wa_goat_mountain_east_peak. Looks like the same route-identity-conflation pattern flagged repeatedly in earlier batches (Big Kangaroo, Colonial Peak, Corteo Peak, Cascade Peak East Ridge, etc.) -- a human rename/split decision, not a fact to patch.

Could not confirm the correct spelling from accessible sources (Mountain Project, SummitPost, CascadeClimbers' First Ascents wiki, and the relevant NWMJ archive page were all inaccessible to this run); one weak signal (a different NWMJ page mentioning a 'Dave Hiser' on an unrelated Mount Terror climb) is not specific enough to settle it. Left flagged rather than guessed.

wa_goode_mountain_northeast_face: its own fa field states a specific, confident first ascent ('Fred Beckey and John Parrott, 1954'), but its own data_quality.gaps field says 'No confirmed first-ascent party/date found for this specific line' -- a direct internal contradiction this run could not resolve externally (no dedicated source found distinct from the well-documented Northeast Buttress). Hozomeen Mountain's area elevation_ft (8072) was a 1-ft outlier against its own Southeast Face route's high_point_ft (8071, already correct) and external sources (Wikipedia: 8,071 ft NAVD 88); fixed. Helmet Butte's area elevation_ft and its Standard Route's high_point_ft both read 7372, but the route's own `corrections` field already documents a prior research pass concluding 'research supports 7,400 ft (Wikipedia, most consistently corroborated topo/USGS figure)' -- the correction was written down but never applied to the actual columns; independently corroborated (Wikipedia, peakery.com) and applied to both rows.
flags: wa_hozomeen_mountain_southeast_face: its own `corrections` field is a detailed self-audit stating this route's name/id ('Southeast Face (Standard)') doesn't correspond to any documented route on Hozomeen's main (North, 8,071 ft) summit -- every source checked describes the standard/easiest route there as the Northeast Ridge/Buttress (1904 FA, class 4), which is what this entry's fields (fa, aspect=E-SE vs corrected NE, gain/loss, etc.) actually document under a mismatched name. A real 'Southeast Buttress' exists (FA 1988, III 5.6) but on a separate sub-summit (South Peak, 8,003 ft) about a mile away. This audit's external checks corroborate the corrections field's account (1904 Tatum/Loudon FA, 8,071 ft) but the row's own name/id vs. content mismatch is a rename/split decision for a human, not a field patch -- left as flagged rather than auto-fixed, consistent with the same conflation pattern flagged in prior batches (Big Kangaroo, Cascade Peak East Ridge, Goat Mountain, etc.).

wa_hadley_peak (area + both routes, elevation_ft/high_point_ft = 7522): external sources disagree with each other (7,470 / 7,513 / 7,515 / 7,516 ft depending on source) and none exactly match the on-file 7,522 ft, so this wasn't fixed -- but the area's stored lat/lng (48.814065, -121.822285) matched an independently found GPS reading (48.8140103, -121.8223671) to five decimal places, which is a stronger corroboration signal than the noisy elevation figures and argues against blindly averaging the external numbers. Left as-is; flagging so a future pass with topo/LIDAR access can resolve the elevation cleanly.

wa_honeymoon_route: FA claim ('1965 Arnie & Diane Bloomer') could not be corroborated by this run's external searches, consistent with the route's own data_quality.gaps note already flagging it as 'unverified/single-source'. Also noticed gain_ft (7861) is markedly higher than loss_ft (5400) for what the route's own descent text describes as an out-and-back via Royal Basin -- an out-and-back should have gain roughly equal to loss; worth a human recheck of whether gain_ft was miscomputed or copied from a different itinerary.

batches.note: Ingalls Peak's two routes each had a self-contradiction between a field and the row's own overview/itinerary text, same pattern as many prior batches: East Peak's fa misspelled 'Butchart' as 'Butcharc' (overview already had it right), its grade_num (5) didn't match the DB-wide YDS-digit convention for '5.3' (should be 3), and its gain_ft/loss_ft (4200/4200) contradicted the row's own itinerary, which had already recomputed 3300/3300 in a sourceNote but never propagated it to the top-level columns; South Ridge's fa misnamed the second 1941 climber 'Ken Colbert' (external sources agree on 'Ken Solberg') and was missing loss_ft entirely despite a populated gain_ft/itinerary. Both Inner Constance routes in scope carried the same stale 7670-vs-7672 elevation offset already flagged and corrected in earlier batches' similar cases -- fixed to match the area row and the routes' own LiDAR-sourced overview text (a third sibling, wa_inner_constance_seans_route, has the identical error but is tagged discipline 'trad' and out of scope, flagged instead per the batch-14 precedent for out-of-scope siblings). Johannesburg Mountain's Northeast Buttress had a badly wrong high_point_ft (9220, not even close to the peak's real 8,200 ft summit -- contradicted by the row's own waypoints) and a pitches count (30) that contradicted three of its own internal citations of '20 pitches'; both fixed from the row's own already-correct internal data. King Kong (Mount Stuart) had an approach field copy-pasted wholesale from a north-side Stuart route (Stuart Lake/Icicle Creek) while its own waypoints and face field describe the south-side Esmeralda/Goat Pass approach shared with its sibling wa_gorillas_direct -- rewrote using the verified sibling's approach text; also filled a null high_point_ft from the row's own summit waypoint. Johannesburg's CJ Couloir and Inspiration Peak's West Ridge both audited clean. New pattern this batch, not seen before: Jack Mountain's high_point_ft (9075) agrees across all 6 of its own routes but conflicts with its own area row's elevation_ft (9069) -- a real external datum split (NAVD88 vs NGVD29 sources), flagged for a human to standardize across the whole peak rather than patched piecemeal on one route.
flags: wa_jack_mountain_northeast_glacier (+ area, + 5 other Jack Mountain routes out of batch scope): high_point_ft=9075 is unanimous across all 6 of the peak's routes but conflicts with the area's own elevation_ft=9069; both figures are independently attested externally (9075 per Wikipedia/AllTrails/FKT, ~9066-9069 per peakery.com/older USGS datum) -- needs a human to pick one value/datum and apply it consistently across the whole peak rather than a single-route patch.

wa_johannesburg_mountain_northeast_buttress: fa/beta disagree on Tom Miller's unnamed 1951 partner, and a separate sibling row (wa_johannesburg_mountain_northeast_rib_1951_route) carries an undated/unattributed '1951' FA that may document the same historical climb -- possible duplicate-route-identity split (same family as prior batches' Dragontail Peak r3/r4 flags), needs a human with guidebook/AAC archive access.

wa_king_kong_gorillas_direct_direct: fa says 'Sol Wertkin & Tyree Johnson, 2016 (freed by Sol Wertkin)' while beta says 'First ascent...by Sol Wertkin and Jon Gleason' -- likely an FA-vs-FFA (first free ascent) mixup between two different partners/sub-events, couldn't be resolved to which field should say what from available sources.

wa_klawatti_peak_southeast_face: a 'Bergschrund' waypoint's latitude is ~6.3 km off from the very next (summit) waypoint despite distMi implying they're ~0.2 mi apart -- almost certainly a coordinate typo, but no source found to confirm the intended value.

wa_inner_constance_standard: the row's own `corrections` field already documents an unresolved route-identity conflict between its name/approach text (long Crystal Pass line) and its own overview/waypoints (shorter South Gully/Route 2A line) -- needs a human rewrite/split decision, not a field patch.
wa_inner_constance_seans_route: same 7670-vs-7672 elevation slip as this batch's two Inner Constance fixes, but discipline='trad', out of this audit's scope -- flagged only.

batches.note: Kyes Peak's own area row was a 2 ft elevation outlier (7282) against both of its own in-DB routes (7280, unanimous) and external sources (Wikipedia/Peakbagger: 7,280+ ft NGVD 29) -- fixed the area to 7280, same systematic-offset pattern as batch 16's Inner Constance fix but this time the area was the wrong value, not the routes. Klawatti Peak SW Buttress, Labor Pains, and both Lane Peak snow couloirs already covered this pass (Zipper, Fly) audited clean -- elevations, FA, and grades all corroborated externally (Wikipedia, AAC publications, SummitPost). No action needed on Kololo Peaks' elevation (8240) despite a Wikipedia infobox rounding to 8,200 ft -- peakery.com independently corroborates the on-file 8,240 ft exactly, and it's internally consistent between the area and route rows.
flags: wa_koala_krack: this row's own `corrections` field already flags that no Mountain Project/SuperTopo page named 'Koala Krack' could be found on Kangaroo Temple; this pass additionally confirmed a same-named 'Koala Rock' formation does exist on Mountain Project but is an unrelated Smith Rock, Oregon crag ('The Marsupials' area) -- a name collision, not evidence of a misplaced route. Grade/FA/area placement left unverified either way.

wa_kololo_peaks_standard: gain_ft (6120) and loss_ft (7000) fail the gain-loss = net-elevation-change identity that holds on this batch's own Kyes Peak route (gain 6023 - loss 707 = 5316 vs actual net 5330) -- here gain-loss = -880 against an implied net one-way climb of +6190 ft (trailhead 2050 ft to high_point_ft 8240 ft). gain_ft is plausible; loss_ft (7000) has no support in the route's own approach/descent text (only minor basin dips described) and no external source states a specific correct figure, so flagged rather than guessed.

wa_lane_peak_r3 (Lover's Lane): grade/grade_system/grade_num are all null unlike its two siblings (Zipper wi3, Fly wi2), despite its own watch_out text referencing 'the moderate AI1 rating' as a baseline that never made it into the grade fields -- and AI1 sits oddly next to this row's own overview calling it the steepest/narrowest of the three couloirs. A Mountain Project page for 'Lover's Lane' exists but its exact grade could not be retrieved this pass -- needs a human with page access or a guidebook.

Le Conte Mountain and Mount Stone traverse both had the same Dome-Peak-family contamination pattern from batch 8 (wrong ranger district/trailhead/corridor bleeding into access sub-fields from an unrelated nearby drainage). Gunn Peak and Lexington Tower each had internal waypoint/gain-loss/rappel-vs-descent-text self-contradictions resolved from the rows' own other fields. Three Liberty Bell routes had a county-straddle field disagreeing with the area row and, on two of them, with the row's own emergency.notes.

wa_liberty_bell_east_face / wa_liberty_and_injustice_for_all: both routes' own approach/road fields describe an SR-20 pullout approach while their own waypoints/gpx point to Blue Lake Trailhead -- internally split, no independent beta found to arbitrate.

batches.note: Northwest Face's alpine_grade held 'III', a plain copy of its own commitment field (NCCS Roman numeral) sitting in the column migrations/0006_composite_grades.sql defines as the French adjectival scale -- same bug as batch 9's Triple Couloirs fix; aligned to 'D' matching every other Liberty Bell rock route in this batch. Serpentine Crack had a leaked meta-comment in a waypoint note ('Reused coordinate from this session's own Liberty Bell area research') -- replaced with the standard trailhead text used on its siblings. Thin Red Line's fa dropped Kate Rutherford from the FFA credit despite the row's own overview already naming her; Liberty Crack's summit waypoint elevation (7746) was the sole outlier against the area row and five sibling routes' 7720; Liberty Crack (Free)'s fa dated the Schaefer/Lee/Herrington/Hadley free variation to 2017 when Herrington's own blog and a CascadeClimbers TR date it 6/28/2016 -- all three fixed. Liberty Ridge finish's fa misspelled 'Jim Burrow' for 'Jim Borrow' (confirmed via AAC publication + the row's own correct overview spelling). Biggest find: both Liberty Cap routes cited stale Rainier summit facts -- Liberty Cap at 14,112 ft (vs. the area row's already-researched 14,097/~14,095 ft) and Columbia Crest as the 'true summit' at 14,411/14,409 ft, when a widely-reported Aug 28, 2024 GPS survey (Seattle Met, Seattle Times, Newsweek, GPS World) found the crater's southwest rim now stands higher (~14,400 ft) than the faster-thinning Columbia Crest (~14,389 ft) -- Columbia Crest hasn't been the true high point since ~2014. batches.note: Three peaks, 10 routes (Mount Shuksan carries 7). Biggest find: a 'Heliotrope Ridge Trailhead' waypoint (48.795,-121.66) contaminated both the North Face and Price Glacier routes -- externally confirmed that's Mount BAKER's Coleman/Deming trailhead, an entirely different mountain, contradicting each route's own approach/approach_logistics/road text. Fixed both using already-correct sibling waypoints on the same peak (Hanging Glacier's corrected White Salmon TH for North Face; Beckey-Schmidtke's Nooksack Cirque TH for Price Glacier, which explicitly states it shares Price Glacier's trailhead). Fisher Chimneys had the same pattern one route over: its 'Lake Ann Trailhead' waypoint (48.805,-121.66, 2800 ft) didn't match its own already-correct approach_logistics coordinates/elevation (48.8500241,-121.6861633, 4770 ft) or the externally-confirmed real Lake Ann TH (~4,700 ft, Austin Pass) -- fixed to match. Northwest Arete's approach/approach_logistics prose described the wrong side of the mountain entirely (Nooksack Cirque Trail, shared with Price Glacier/Beckey-Schmidtke) contradicting its own face/road/waypoints fields (all White Salmon side) -- confirmed via SummitPost's Northwest Arete page ('parking at the lower White Salmon lodge... following a dirt road up the White Salmon drainage') and rewrote the approach text plus fixed the structured trailhead fields. Also fixed a real rendering bug on Fisher Chimneys: watch_out was stored as one newline-joined string instead of a JSON array; lib/db.js's toArr() only splits on commas, not newlines, so the app would render all 12 items as a single run-on bullet -- converted to a proper array, verified by reading the app's own parsing code (read-only; no app code touched). Confirmed the 'Mount Tom area, North Cascades' DB-wide junk clause (first found in batch 15) on 3 more routes (Hanging Glacier, Price Glacier, Sulphide Glacier access.notes) and stripped it. Mount Sefrit's Southwest Ridge had a familiar never-propagated-correction bug: its own `corrections` field already explains fa should be left null since the mountain's 1930 FA isn't confirmed as this specific line, but the fa column still held it -- cleared to match. Mount Seattle's Seattle Creek Basin Route had the same null-top-level-grade-despite-populated-beta bug fixed on its own sibling Noyes Basin in batch 30 -- filled the same way. FA history for Beckey-Schmidtke (Beckey/Schmidtke, July 5 1946) and Price Glacier (Beckey/Schwabland/Granston, 1945) were both independently corroborated externally (AAC/Alpine Journal, Wikipedia) and left untouched.
flags: wa_mount_seattle (area): prominence_ft=758 sits between two external figures found this pass (Wikipedia 726 ft vs. PeakVisor ~768 ft) -- not a clear outlier against either and no DB-internal contradiction found, so left as-is; noting only in case a future pass finds a definitive source.

wa_mount_sefrit_southwest_ridge / wa_mount_shuksan_fisher_chimneys / wa_mount_shuksan_sulphide_glacier: grade_num handling for Class-4-labeled routes is inconsistent within this single batch -- Southwest Ridge stores grade_num=4 for 'Class 4' while Fisher Chimneys and Sulphide Glacier both store grade_num=0 for their own 'Class 4' component. No schema documentation found settling which convention is correct, and it's not a self-contradiction within any one row, so left unfixed; worth a dedicated pass to establish the intended convention DB-wide.

Checked available sources (Nelson/Potterfield via search, SummitPost) for Price Glacier specifically and found only NCCS/YDS/ice grades cited, no French adjectival letter -- consistent with batch 29's finding that PNW glacier/alpine routes usually aren't assigned one. Left unfixed rather than guess.

batches.note: Four peaks/areas (Shuksan, Spickard, St. Helens, Steel, Stuart -- 5 areas), 10 routes (Stuart carries 5). Two watch_out-stored-as-newline-string rendering bugs found and fixed (White Salmon Glacier, Ice Cliff Glacier, Stuart Glacier Couloir -- 3 routes, same pattern as Fisher Chimneys in batch 31), each paired with the recurring Mount Tom area, North Cascades junk clause in access.notes on the same three rows. Mount Stuart North Ridge (Complete) fa credited Hargis/Ossiander with the right climbers but the wrong year (1963, actually Beckey/Marts lower-ridge variation) -- corroborated via multiple independent searches that Hargis/Ossiander toe-to-summit-over-the-Gendarme line dates to 1970; fixed with added context distinguishing all three historical ascents (Claunch/Rupley 1956, Beckey/Marts 1963, Hargis/Ossiander 1970). Mount Spickard Southwest corrections field claimed to use 8,980 ft while high_point_ft actually stored 8979 -- fixed the text to match the stored value rather than pick a winner among genuinely conflicting external elevation figures (8978-8983 across sources). Mount Stuart North Face was already correctly flagged unverified/fabricated-duplicate by a prior research pass (2026-07-28) -- confirmed the flag is accurate (no such named route in any source checked) and left as-is, no new action needed.

Five peaks, 10 routes (Stuart 2, Teneriffe 2, Terror 4, Thomson 1, Tom 1). Mount Stuart West Ridge had two related approach-side errors: its own approach text gave the Esmeralda/Ingalls Way trailhead elevation as ~5,500 ft, self-contradicted by its own next sentence's math (Longs Pass ~6,400 ft minus ~2,100 ft gain implies ~4,300 ft) and by external sources (mountainwerks.org: 4,243 ft); and its first waypoint/gpx point stored a coordinate ~2.5 mi east of the real trailhead with a mismatched elevation (3,200 ft) -- same copied-coordinate-onto-wrong-point bug as batch 27 -- fixed using the row's own correct approach_logistics trailhead coords plus the confirmed 4,243 ft. Mount Terror's West Ridge and Stoddard Buttress routes both had the recurring null-top-level-grade-despite-consistent-subfields bug (batches 6/10/17/19/26/30/31) -- filled from their own already-agreeing alpine_grade/rock_grade/commitment. Flagged rather than fixed: West Ridge's itinerary.schedule references Stuart Lake TH/Stuart Pass, contradicting this route's own Esmeralda-side approach (likely cross-route contamination); West Ridge's grade text says NCCS III while commitment/alpine_grade both say II (no source resolved which); Stoddard Buttress's fa splits one likely single 1984 solo push (per secondary AAC/NWMJ summaries) into two ascents a year apart, but every primary source 403'd this run so it wasn't rewritten; East Ridge's (wa_mount_terror_southeast_face) pre-existing self-flagged id/name mismatch was re-confirmed still present; Mount Thomson West Ridge's 4-person 1940 FA credit is only half-corroborated (Beckey brothers confirmed, Craig/Ford not found either way). Gendarme, both Teneriffe routes, Terror North Face, and Mount Tom's Glacier/Scramble Route audited clean.

Six peaks, 8 routes (Torment 2, Cathedral 1, Needle 1, Snowfield 1, North Early Winters Spire 1, Nooksack Tower 2). Needle Peak North Ridge and Nooksack Tower South Face audited clean.

Right had high_point_ft (7569) contradicting its own summit waypoint (7560) and external sources -- fixed to 7560. Colchuck Peak's Northeast Buttress fa field misattributed Mark Weigelt's real 1970 FA (Backbone Ridge on neighboring Dragontail Peak, with John Bonneville, not Julie Brugger) to this route -- classic cross-peak contamination; set to unverified rather than guess a replacement since no source ties an actual FA party to this route. Lexington Tower North Face, Castle Peak's Fight or Flight, and Cutthroat Peak's North Ridge all audited clean (FA/grade/elevation/approach independently confirmed); Primus Peak's North Ridge existing FA data-quality flag left standing -- circumstantially better supported this pass (AAC 1987 AAJ entry title, Bebie obituary) but article text unreadable, so not marked resolved. Minor unresolved items (Cutthroat's third FA climber surname Kenney vs Kennedy, its West Ridge rappel count, North Gardner's trailhead elevation, Whatcom's route-specific FA claim) flagged, not fixed.

Eight peaks (Mount Formidable, Johannesburg Mountain, Argonaut Peak, Sloan Peak, Kangaroo Temple, South Early Winters Spire, Northwest Mox Peak, Dorado Needle), 8 routes. Dorado Needle's Northwest Ridge had its trailhead waypoint (and matching first gpx point) stored ~8km from the real trailhead, contradicted by its own approach_logistics field and all 4 sibling Eldorado Peak routes sharing the same real trailhead -- fixed both. (Remsberg Variation), and Old Snowy Mountain's South Ridge/PCT route all audited clean.

batches.note: Seven peaks, 8 routes (Unicorn Peak, Ottohorn x2, Overcoat Peak, Pernod Spire, Phantom Peak, Point Success, and the route literally named 'Poltergeist Pinnacle' filed under Mount Challenger's area_id).
